subject: LaunchFoundry stipend top-up & billing routing
messages:
From: Tara Lin <tara@launchfoundry.org>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time stipend top-up + invoicing path

Hi Mina —

Quick one from our side: we had an unusually strong cohort demo week and three fellows went through more CI than their sandbox allowance, which put them above the trial stipend cap. The accelerator covers micro-billing in most cases but this is a material overage across three teams (~$2.8k total).

Our CFO asked if Redwood can do a one-time top-up (convert overage into a single invoice line) and for clarity on whether the bill can be issued to LaunchFoundry Finance (same PO # LF-PO-221). If possible we also want the top-up to be applied as a promo credit on the next monthly invoice rather than immediate charge — it helps our accounting flow.

Short asks:
- Can Redwood approve a one-time top-up to cover $2.8k overage for this cohort?
- Can the amount be invoiced to LF-PO-221 and applied as a credit on next invoice?
- Any paperwork you need from us (signed amendment / SOW)?

Appreciate a quick yes/no — we close books next week.

Thanks,
Tara
Program Manager, LaunchFoundry

---
LaunchFoundry Accelerator | launchfoundry.org
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Lin <tara@launchfoundry.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time stipend top-up + invoicing path

Hi Tara — thanks for the note and congrats on the demo week!

We can generally accommodate one-time top-ups for accelerator partners. I looped in Marissa (growth lead for accelerator programs) and Ben (sales ops) so we can confirm the commercial path. A couple quick clarifying points for our finance and contracts:

- Is the $2.8k a net request (no discounts) or are you asking for a promotional waiver/discount on that amount?
- Do you want the amount to appear as an invoice line (charge) and then Redwood will issue a credit on the following invoice, or would you prefer a zero-dollar invoice and a corresponding credit memo?

If you can confirm the preferred accounting flow and share the LF PO, we will draft a pro-forma and MAP amendment if needed.

I can move this fast once Marissa/Ben confirm.

Best,
Mina
Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time stipend top-up + invoicing path

Quick internal recommendation:

- Approve a one-time top-up for $2,800 but apply a 25% promotional concession (net charge $2,100). Wedo this as a customer-favorable gesture for cohort momentum and to keep the LaunchFoundry relationship healthy.
- Billing flow: we issue a standard invoice to LaunchFoundry Finance (LF-PO-221) for $2,100. In parallel we generate a credit memo for $2,100 that will be applied to the next monthly invoice as requested.
- Paperwork: exchange a short SOW amendment (one page) that references the MAP and the invoice/credit memo mechanics. I attached language for the MAP amendment in the shared Drive link.

Ben: can you confirm the GL code and that finance is OK with the invoice + credit memo pattern? If not, what do we need to change to match their AR workflow?

M
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time stipend top-up + invoicing path

On our side finance confirmed the invoice + credit memo flow is acceptable. Quick operational notes:

- GL / AR handling: use GL 4401 (program credits). We'll tag the invoice with deal ID LF-2027-045.
- I prepared a draft pro-forma invoice and an updated MAP excerpt (see links below).
- We should include the MAP amendment text (Marissa) and get Tara to initial/confirm. No legal redline required for a one-off concession under $5k.

Links: https://redwood.app/drive/redwood-proforma-LF-045-0427.pdf
https://redwood.app/drive/MAP-LaunchFoundry-2027-v2

I'll queue the invoice for 4/12 EOD once we have Tara's confirmation on the PO and acceptance of the 25% concession.

Ben
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Lin <tara@launchfoundry.org>, LaunchFoundry Finance <finance@launchfoundry.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time stipend top-up + invoicing path

Hi Tara / Finance team —

Thanks for the quick responses and congrats again on a great demo week. Redwood can do the one-time stipend top-up. Summary and next steps below: 

Summary:
- Approved amount: $2,800 gross; customer concession: 25% -> net charge $2,100.
- Billing: Redwood will issue Invoice #RDW-LF-045 for $2,100 to LaunchFoundry Finance (PO: LF-PO-221).
- Crediting: Redwood will issue Credit Memo CM-RDW-LF-045 for $2,100 which will be applied to LaunchFoundry's next monthly invoice.
- Paperwork: short MAP amendment attached; no legal redlines expected.

Attachments included (stubs):
- redwood-proforma-LF-045-0427.pdf (pro-forma invoice)
- MAP-LaunchFoundry-2027-v2.docx (amendment language)

Action items:
1) Tara / Finance: confirm PO LF-PO-221 is correct and confirm you accept the 25% concession and the invoice+credit memo flow. Reply with a one-line acceptance and we'll queue invoice for 2027-04-12.
2) Once confirmed Redwood will send the formal invoice and the credit memo; the credit will appear on your next monthly invoice as requested.

If you prefer a zero-dollar invoice + credit memo combo instead, we can do that but it requires a slightly different AR posting; let us know.

Thanks — happy to walk through with your finance team on a call if helpful.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Partnerships — Redwood Inference
